parameters.name: DurationSeconds
parameters.description:
The validity period of the token. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 3600. Minimum value: 900. Maximum value: the value specified by `MaxSessionDuration`.

To set the maximum session duration `MaxSessionDuration` for a role, see [CreateRole](~~28710~~) or [UpdateRole](~~28712~~).

parameters.name: OIDCProviderArn
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC IdP.

You can view the ARN of the OIDC IdP in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console or by calling an API operation:

- RAM console: See [View the information of an OIDC IdP](~~327123~~).
- API: See [GetOIDCProvider](~~327126~~) or [ListOIDCProviders](~~327127~~).

parameters.name: OIDCToken
parameters.description:
The OIDC token issued by the external IdP.

Length: 4 to 20,000 characters.

> Provide the original OIDC token without Base64 decoding.

parameters.name: Policy
parameters.description:
An additional permission policy attached to the STS token to further restrict its permissions:

- If you specify access policy, the final permissions of the STS token are the intersection of the RAM role permissions and access policy.
- If you do not specify access policy, the final permissions of the STS token are the permissions of the RAM role.

Length: 1 to 2,048 characters.

parameters.name: RoleArn
parameters.description:
The ARN of the RAM role to assume.

You can view the role ARN in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console or by calling an API operation:

- Resource Access Management (RAM) console: See [How do I view the ARN of a RAM role?](~~39744~~).
- API: See [ListRoles](~~28713~~) or [GetRole](~~28711~~).

parameters.name: RoleSessionName
parameters.description:
The role session name.

This is a user-defined parameter. Set this parameter to the identity of the API caller, such as a username. In ActionTrail logs, you can use different values of RoleSessionName to distinguish actual operators even when the same RAM role is used, enabling user-level access auditing.

Format: The value can contain letters, digits, periods (.), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Length: 2 to 64 characters.
